title: expectrail.run-it-latest/v1
description: latest.json at the root of the run-it-results branch: for each sample, the most recent published run. It is an index only: the page reads the run's own status.json for what the verifier decided, so this file never carries a verdict. Written by expectrail.runit_site.update_latest in the publish job, after expectrail.runit check passed on the folder.
